Now, direction ratio of AO=(a−0, b−0, c−0)=(a, b, c)≡a:b:c and direction ratio of OG=(a/3−0, b/3−0, c/3−0)=(a/3, b/3, c/3)≡a:b:c and direction ratio of AG=(a−a/3, b−b/3, c−c/3)=(2a/3, 2b/3, 2c/3)≡a:b:cSince, direction ratios of points A, O& G are same. So, points A, O& G are colliner.Therefore, area of triangle AOG is 0.
